title: DSH HARNESS OS theme data
description: One themes/*.json file is an array of theme objects. scripts/build-client.mjs merges every file in themes/ into the client bundle, and scripts/check-theme-sync.mjs enforces this schema plus the DSH contract-token coverage.

id.description: Stable machine id, must be unique across every file in themes/. Used by the client to pick the theme.

label.description: Human-facing name shown in the settings row.

colorScheme.description: Which host color scheme this entry is the counterpart of.

tokens.description: Map of CSS custom property -> { light, dark }. Every value must carry BOTH schemes, which is what the DSH theme contract requires.
